title: Repair task-scoped coordinator admission
phase: Source implementation prepared; exact-head structured execution artifacts and independent acceptance still required; author has not accepted or merged

ask.author: Craig
ask.request: Approve one isolated coordinator repair without the global prerequisite, using task-scoped ownership checks, tests and independent review; retain game acceptance, existing owners and deployment restrictions
ask.scope: Only this repair is exempted from the broken repository-wide prerequisite. Every other ownership, source, independent acceptance, test and publication gate remains.

bug_shape: Unmapped main/archive/non-task branches and unnormalized historical task records make repository-wide source completeness a prerequisite for every mutation, blocking independently safe task-scoped actions and the repair itself.

implementation_scope.conditional: Only minimal existing supported coordinator/watch entrypoint wiring if necessary; preserve the evidence-policy evaluator and all acceptance/hold/isolation tests. Own board/registry row and append-only log updates only.
excluded: legacy-route fallback or live dispatcher/collector installation
implementation_scope.registration: This task, one additive existing-board row, one public-role registry reservation and one append-only log entry. No implementation yet.

completion_criteria.criterion: A narrowly scoped operation can be evaluated without normalizing every historical task or asserting repository-wide liveness.
completion_criteria.verification: Positive real docs-only evidence packet and executable scoped operation test; global incomplete inventory remains INPUT_REQUIRED, never global IDLE.

completion_criteria.criterion: Scoped coverage is fail-closed and bound to exact task, operation, executor, owner, full candidate/base heads, source inventory and current rules.
completion_criteria.verification: Mutation tests for changed candidate/base/branch/rules/receipt, stale or missing relevant receipts and unknown sources. No caller-controlled unrelated boolean or prefix-only omission.

completion_criteria.criterion: Historical branches can be accounted for only with verifiable current-base, merged-ancestry or disjoint candidate/dependency/owner-region proof.
completion_criteria.verification: Tests for relevant and unknown branches, proved contained/disjoint branches, sibling PR/branch overlap and shared board-row changes; proof must come from immutable Git objects or explicit complete source receipts, not branch labels.

completion_criteria.criterion: Existing owners, unknown liveness, pending/running queue entries, user holds/stops, provider denials and deploy restrictions are preserved for the relevant scope.
completion_criteria.verification: Negative owner/queue/stop/denial controls and unchanged existing acceptance-isolation, final-guard, operation-needs and hold-invariance suites.

completion_criteria.criterion: Independent evidence acceptance and truthful required checks remain mandatory; documentation does not invent gameplay checks.
completion_criteria.verification: Real docs-only evidence-policy packet with actual acceptance-check result plus absent/failed required-check, failed independent review and stale-rule cases. Author never self-accepts.

completion_criteria.criterion: Supported entrypoints use the same scoped result, with honest runbook source/collector limitations and no legacy bypass.
completion_criteria.verification: CLI and imported coordinator-plan/dispatch-guard and actual supported aliases; existing retired-route probes stay green. Document module bundle and private observation handling; no claim of live scheduler adoption.

completion_criteria.criterion: Separate independent reviewer verifies the exact implementation head and every criterion.
completion_criteria.verification: Committed reproducible local test logs and fixtures, immutable source head and per-criterion independent verdict; no author merge.
